audience.text: Developers building .NET applications that require programmatic 3D scene creation, manipulation, and format conversion without native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct and traverse 3D scene graphs using Scene, Node, and primitive entities like Box, Cylinder, and Sphere.
capabilities.title: Scene graph construction

capabilities.text: Read and write 3D scenes in FBX, glTF, Wavefront OBJ, STL, COLLADA, U3D, 3MF, RVM, AMF, and HTML5/Aspose 3D Web viewer formats.
capabilities.title: Format conversion

capabilities.text: Assign shading materials such as LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, and PbrMaterial, and convert between material types.
capabilities.title: Material assignment and conversion

capabilities.text: Configure per-format load/save behavior using dedicated options types like ObjLoadOptions and ColladaSaveOptions.
capabilities.title: Customizable import/export options

capabilities.text: Animate scenes using AnimationClip, AnimationChannel, KeyFrame, Bone, Skeleton, SkinDeformer, and MorphTargetDeformer.
capabilities.title: Animation support

capabilities.text: Define NURBS curves and surfaces using NurbsCurve and NurbsSurface with control points, weights, and knot vectors.
capabilities.title: NURBS geometry definition

capabilities.text: Read and write per-vertex mesh data including normals, UVs, vertex color, tangent/binormal, smoothing groups, and user data.
capabilities.title: Per-vertex mesh data handling

limitations.text: Rendering is not implemented — Scene.Render and related rendering pipeline components throw NotImplementedException.
NURBS evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion are not functional — NurbsCurve.Evaluate and NurbsSurface.ToMesh throw NotImplementedException.
PolygonModifier and most TriMesh mesh post-processing utilities throw NotImplementedException.
PDF and Google Draco import/export are not functional — PdfFormat and DracoFormat have no reader/writer implementation.
License and trial-management APIs (License, Metered) exist for API compatibility but are not applicable to this open-source edition.
Text watermarking is not currently functional in this FOSS build.

problems_solved.text: Enables 3D scene graph construction from primitives and CAD-style profiles using pure managed code.
Supports round-trip conversion between widely used 3D interchange formats including FBX, glTF, OBJ, STL, COLLADA, and U3D.
Provides shading material support and conversion between material types such as Lambert and PBR.
Eliminates external 3D engine dependencies by offering a self-contained API surface for 3D operations.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source, MIT-licensed .NET library for building and converting 3D scenes without any external 3D engine.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported IFC profiles beyond those explicitly named in examples is not fully enumerated in facts.
Whether all format-specific options types (e.g., RvmLoadOptions, A3dwSaveOptions) have working encoders/decoders behind them is not fully confirmed by examples.
The behavior of Scene.FromStream() and related stream-based APIs beyond the COLLADA example is not explicitly demonstrated.
The scope of vertex declaration and vertex element support beyond normals, UVs, and color is not fully detailed in examples.
